result.final_text:
## What this letter says
Yusuf's asthma review appointment is cancelled. The clinic has moved. He has a new appointment instead.

## What you need to do
1. Go to the new appointment on Monday 23 November 2026 at 09:15. It is with the Paediatric Asthma Nurse. It is in Children's Outpatients, Blue Zone.
2. Do not go to the old appointment on 9 November 2026. It is cancelled.
3. Bring all of Yusuf's inhalers. This includes his blue reliever inhaler (salbutamol). It also includes his brown preventer inhaler (beclometasone).
4. Bring his spacer.
5. Bring his personal child health record (red book), if you have it.
6. If the new time is not suitable, call 01632 960 588.
7. Keep giving Yusuf his brown preventer inhaler every day. Give it even when he is well.

## Dates and medicines
- 9 November 2026: old asthma review appointment. It is cancelled.
- Monday 23 November 2026 at 09:15: new asthma review appointment. It is with the Paediatric Asthma Nurse, Children's Outpatients, Blue Zone.
- Brown preventer inhaler (beclometasone): the dose is not stated in the letter. Give it every day, even when he is well. There is no change. Keep giving it.

## Questions to ask your doctor
- Where is the new clinic, and how do I get there?
- Is there anything else I should bring on 23 November?
- What should I do if I cannot make the new time?

## When to get urgent help
The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
